description: Four wands, and the short loaf

participation.context: Ate, left the cat, and said the glass was not bought.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

participation.context: Set the loaf against the notch, named the three marks, and sent him to wash.
participation.name: Mistress Dorcas Ansell

participation.context: Brought four peeled wands and would not lift the cat.
participation.name: Alse Pinder

participation.context: Said he would learn three marks and not invent a fourth.
participation.name: Gillis Verbeke

participation.context: Sat on the shut chronicle and did not move.
participation.name: Gib

relations.note: she measures the loaf and his hour

story.body: You ate the short loaf, left Gib on the shut chronicle, and said the glass John had priced at four shillings was not bought. Alse counted four wands. Mistress Ansell sent you to wash before church.

relations.note: she measures the loaf and his hour

title: Ate the short loaf before church

participation.context: attendee in Wands at the wall
participation.name: William Shakespeare

participation.context: Held the book at the wall.
participation.name: Master Josias Thwaite

story.body: You stood at the wall. The boys had willow wands. Master Thwaite had the book.

title: Stood at the wall while the boys beat it with willow wands

participation.context: Kept the three names plain and left the precept as talk.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

participation.context: Read a psalm-verse and a prayer for the fruits at the marks, and called the forty minutes done.
participation.name: Master Josias Thwaite

participation.context: Served the short loaf and would not obey a paper she had not got.
participation.name: Mistress Dorcas Ansell

participation.context: Showed the third mark, and said she had shown the first two.
participation.name: Alse Pinder

participation.context: Said the three names back and stopped.
participation.name: Gillis Verbeke

relations.note: she shows him the parish marks
relations.quote: That is the third mark, Master Gillis.

story.body: You heard the three marks named, heard that a precept against blue starch was coming from Crosby Place, and left it unread. The loaf was still a finger and a half short. You did not add a fourth mark.

relations.note: she shows him the parish marks
relations.quote: That is the third mark, Master Gillis.

title: Heard the three marks named and of the blue-starch precept
